claims.assertion: Yazhi describes the Moon as an artificial, layered structure with habitable areas and central reactors.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her account conflicts with terrestrial astronomy.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says a group of surface lenses generates the lunar hologram and that four or fewer of twelve old ionizing reactors power it and the Van Allen belts.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi claims the Moon’s frequency affects human reproductive cycles and says some Lyrian women can control fertility mentally.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Unverified biological claims; presented as lore.

review_flags: Claims about lunar construction, Van Allen radiation, and reproductive biology contradict established terrestrial science and are retained only as attributed lore.
coverage_gaps: The source also discusses lunar orbit control, Tiamat, portals, sunlight, and proposed retirement of the Moon.
